title: "Interactive Confidence Explorer"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
pacman::p_load(ordbetareg)
```

# Interactive Confidence Explorer

Explore how the three noise parameters (σe, σk, σm) affect the relationship between evidence and confidence.

```{r shiny_app, echo=FALSE}
shinyApp(
  
  ui = fluidPage(
    titlePanel("Interactive Confidence Explorer"),
    
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        sliderInput("sigma_e", 
                    "Evidence Noise (σe):", 
                    min = 0, max = 10, value = 1, step = 0.1),
        sliderInput("sigma_k", 
                    "Threshold Noise (σk):", 
                    min = 0, max = 10, value = 1, step = 0.1),
        sliderInput("sigma_m", 
                    "Metacognitive Noise (σm):", 
                    min = 0, max = 10, value = 1, step = 0.1),
        hr(),
        h4("Summary Statistics"),
        p("Fixed: 5000 trials per simulation"),
        verbatimTextOutput("summary_stats")
      ),
      
      mainPanel(
        tabsetPanel(
          tabPanel("Evidence vs Confidence", 
                   plotOutput("plot_e_C", height = "650px")),
          tabPanel("Stimulus vs Confidence", 
                   plotOutput("plot_SS_C", height = "650px")),
          tabPanel("Both Plots",
                   plotOutput("plot_SS_C_both", height = "650px")),
          tabPanel("Evidence vs Stimulus",
                   plotOutput("plot_evid_stim", height = "650px"))
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  
  server = function(input, output, session) {
    
    # Reactive expression to generate simulated data whenever sliders change
    sim_data <- reactive({
      req(input$sigma_e, input$sigma_k, input$sigma_m)
      
      # Set seed for reproducibility
      set.seed(199742)
      
      # Simulation parameters
      n_trials <- 5000
      sigma_e <- max(input$sigma_e, 0.001)
      sigma_k <- max(input$sigma_k, 0.001)
      sigma_m <- max(input$sigma_m, 0.001)
      conf_prec <- 500
      c0 <- -3
      c1 <- 3
      
      # Generate data
      X <- abs(rnorm(n_trials, 2, 1))
      D <- sample(c(-1, 1), n_trials, replace = TRUE)
      e <- rnorm(n_trials, mean = D * X, sd = sigma_e)
      ehat <- rnorm(n_trials, e, sigma_m)
      k_gauss <- rnorm(n_trials, 0, sigma_k)
      p_gauss <- pnorm(e / sigma_k)
      a <- rbinom(n_trials, 1, p_gauss)
      
      c_mu <- ifelse(a == 1, 
                     plogis(2 * ehat * X / (sigma_e^2 + sigma_m^2)),
                     1 - plogis(2 * ehat * X / (sigma_e^2 + sigma_m^2)))
      c_mu <- pmax(0.001, pmin(0.999, c_mu))
      C <- ordbetareg::rordbeta(n_trials, c_mu, conf_prec, c(c0, c1))
      
      ACC <- ifelse(a == 0 & D == -1, 1, ifelse(a == 1 & D == 1, 1, 0))
      SS <- D * X
      
      df <- data.frame(
        e = e,
        ehat = ehat,
        C = C,
        a = a,
        X = X,
        D = D,
        ACC = ACC,
        SS = SS
      )
      
      return(df)
    })
    
    
    # Plot: Evidence vs Confidence
    output$plot_e_C <- renderPlot({
      df <- sim_data()
      
      # Bin evidence into 10 bins
      df %>%
        mutate(e_bin = cut(e, breaks = 10, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
        group_by(e_bin, ACC) %>%
        summarize(
          mean_C = mean(C),
          se_C = sd(C) / sqrt(n()),
          e_mid = mean(e),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = e_mid, y = mean_C, color = as.factor(ACC))) +
        geom_point(size = 3) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_C - 1.96 * se_C, 
                         ymax = mean_C + 1.96 * se_C), 
                     width = 0.3, linewidth = 1) +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = c("0" = "#D64D4D", "1" = "#4DB84D"),
          labels = c("Incorrect", "Correct"),
          name = "Accuracy"
        ) +
        labs(
          title = "Evidence vs Confidence",
          x = "Evidence (e)",
          y = "Mean Confidence"
        ) +
        ylim(0, 1) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        theme(legend.position = "top")
    })
    
    # Plot: Signed Stimulus vs Confidence
    output$plot_SS_C <- renderPlot({
           df <- sim_data()
      
      # Bin signed stimulus into 10 bins
      df %>%
        mutate(SS = D*X,
               SS_bin = cut(SS, breaks = 10, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
        group_by(SS_bin, ACC) %>%
        summarize(
          mean_C = mean(C),
          se_C = sd(C) / sqrt(n()),
          SS_mid = mean(SS),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = SS_mid, y = mean_C, color = as.factor(ACC))) +
        geom_point(size = 3) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_C - 1.96 * se_C, 
                         ymax = mean_C + 1.96 * se_C), 
                     width = 0.3, linewidth = 1) +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = c("0" = "#D64D4D", "1" = "#4DB84D"),
          labels = c("Incorrect", "Correct"),
          name = "Accuracy"
        ) +
        labs(
          title = "Signed Stimulus vs Confidence (binned)",
          x = "Signed Stimulus",
          y = "Mean Confidence"
        ) +
        ylim(0, 1) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        theme(legend.position = "top")
    })
    

    
    output$plot_SS_C_both <- renderPlot({
      req(sim_data())
      df <- sim_data()
      
      p1 = df %>%
        mutate(SS = D*X,
               SS_bin = cut(SS, breaks = 10, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
        group_by(SS_bin, ACC) %>%
        summarize(
          mean_C = mean(C),
          se_C = sd(C) / sqrt(n()),
          SS_mid = mean(SS),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = SS_mid, y = mean_C, color = as.factor(ACC))) +
        geom_point(size = 3) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_C - 1.96 * se_C, 
                         ymax = mean_C + 1.96 * se_C), 
                     width = 0.3, linewidth = 1) +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = c("0" = "#D64D4D", "1" = "#4DB84D"),
          labels = c("Incorrect", "Correct"),
          name = "Accuracy"
        ) +
        labs(
          title = "Signed Stimulus vs Confidence",
          x = "Signed Stimulus",
          y = "Mean Confidence"
        ) +
        ylim(0, 1) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        theme(legend.position = "top")
      
      
      p2 = df %>%
        mutate(e_bin = cut(e, breaks = 10, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
        group_by(e_bin, ACC) %>% 
        summarize(
          mean_C = mean(C),
          se_C = sd(C) / sqrt(n()),
          e_mid = mean(e),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = e_mid, y = mean_C, color = as.factor(ACC))) +
        geom_point(size = 2) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_C - 1.96 * se_C, ymax = mean_C + 1.96 * se_C), 
                     width = 0.2) +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = c("0" = "#D64D4D", "1" = "#4DB84D"),
          labels = c("Incorrect", "Correct"),
          name = "Accuracy"
        ) +
        labs(title = "Evidence vs Confidence", x = "Evidence", y = "Mean Confidence") +
        ylim(0, 1) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
      
      p1|p2
      
    })
    
    # Plot: Evidence vs Stimulus (colored by accuracy)
    output$plot_evid_stim <- renderPlot({
      req(sim_data())
      df <- sim_data()
      
      ggplot(df, aes(x = SS, y = e, color = as.factor(ACC))) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = c("0" = "#D64D4D", "1" = "#4DB84D"),
          labels = c("Incorrect", "Correct"),
          name = "Accuracy"
        ) +
        labs(
          title = "Evidence vs Signed Stimulus by Accuracy",
          subtitle = sprintf("σ_e = %.1f  |  σ_k = %.1f  |  σ_m = %.1f", 
                            input$sigma_e, input$sigma_k, input$sigma_m),
          x = "Signed Stimulus (D × X)",
          y = "Evidence (e)"
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        theme(
          legend.position = "top",
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40")
        )
    })
  },
  
  options = list(height = 800)
)
```
